Babylon Bee chief Seth Dillon meets Joe Rogan in person for episode 1857. Dillon had led the satire site through bans and rapid growth. The Bee began in 2016 under founder Adam Ford.

Dillon says no one was doing satire from a conservative view at the time. He describes filling that gap with joke headlines that often came true. Rogan asks about attacks, fact checks, and social media bans. The talk shows how a small joke site became a culture-war flashpoint, and why its fans defend it so fiercely. Neither man treats satire as a small thing.
